category_title: Gifted girls with ADHD experiencing organizational failure and academic anxiety
minimal_context: The student is attempting to complete a large volume of Algebra 2 homework.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's look at your Algebra 2 homework. You have a lot of problems to finish today.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I was struggling. I just wasn't getting what he said at all. Since I was GT, most of the kids got stuff faster than me, so I wouldn't really get the material.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just keep trying. Let's work on the next section.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I spend a lot of time doing homework or attempting to do homework. There's a lot of time spent not doing homework but not doing anything else either because I still have homework to do, if that makes sense.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You just need to focus and get it done so you can turn it in.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: He gave out a lot of homework that I couldn't really finish and if I did, I forgot to turn it in so I got marked off a lot for that. I wanted to cry.
